description: Gemini on Vertex AI for the text; word times by local forced alignment of the Gemini text to the audio (torchaudio MMS_FA, CTC, pinned weights, CPU, no network once cached; needs server/requirements-align.txt). Every word gets a time and an acoustic score; a segment is word-citable only when its mean score is at least 0.7. On the three pilot phone calls it made fewer segments citable than asr-vertex-gemini-aligned (27 vs 77 at score 0.5) and failed on the quieter remote speaker, so it is not the default. Not verification of what was said.
